title: Reindeer Eyes Turn From Gold to Blue Every Winter

scenes.text: Reindeer eyes change colour with the seasons.
In summer, the back of their eyes glows gold.
By winter, it turns deep blue.
Scientists had never seen a colour change like this in any mammal.
It happens as months of darkness keep their pupils wide open.
Gold in summer, blue in winter. Watch their eyes change.

description:
Reindeer eyes shift from gold in summer to deep blue in winter, a first in mammals.
The change is linked to pressure inside the eye during the dark Arctic winter.
What other animal has a superpower we have never noticed?
first_comment: Which animal adaptation surprised you most?
